title: HOW CAN I CURSE WHAT GOD HAS BLESSED

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then Balaam spoke his message: "Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains. 'Come,' he said, 'curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.' How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the LORD has not denounced?" - Num 23:7-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Balaam begins his first oracle, and immediately the whole plan unravels. He recalls how Balak summoned him to curse Israel, and then asks the question that overturns everything: how can he curse those whom God has not cursed? The curse simply cannot be pronounced, because God has not pronounced it.

Here is a truth that should steady every believer. No one can curse whom God has blessed. Balak's silver, Balaam's reputation, the seven altars, none of it could reverse God's favour toward His people. What God declares, no human power can undo. His blessing is not subject to veto by any enemy.

This does not mean God's people never face trouble. Israel would still know hardship and discipline. But no outside force could remove them from the Lord's covenant love. Their security rested not in their own strength but in the unbreakable word of God.

For those who belong to Christ, this security is even surer. In Him, believers are blessed with every spiritual blessing, and no accusation can stand against God's chosen ones (Rom 8:33). The enemy may accuse, oppose, and scheme, but he cannot curse what God has blessed. Rest today in the unshakable favour that is yours in Christ.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you rest in the truth that no enemy can curse what God has blessed?
2. How does God's unbreakable favour steady you in hard times?
3. What accusation or fear do you need to surrender to God's blessing?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that no scheme or accusation can undo the blessing You have spoken over Your people in Christ. Help me rest in Your unshakable favour today. Amen.
